name: Valentina Yamamoto
role: Apprentice electrician, junior member of Ironvein maintenance guild
description:
Valentina Yamamoto is compact and strong-shouldered from two years of hauling conduit and cable through the industrial guts of Ironvein. Their skin is a warm medium-brown with undertones their Dembélé grandmother called 'sunset-red,' and they keep their hair cropped close on the sides and voluminous on top, dyed in shifting copper tones that complement the burn marks on their forearms — small constellations of arc-flash scars they show off with particular pride. A tail modification — copper-tipped, prehensile, and genuinely useful for steadying themselves on narrow catwalks — is their one major geneware investment, bought with eight months of saved stipend.

Valentina Yamamoto is practical and funny in equal measure, with the bone-deep competence of someone who learned early that doing the work correctly is the only currency that doesn't get devalued. They are apprenticed to a master electrician named Goran who is exacting and often unkind, and Valentina Yamamoto has decided that enduring Goran is simply a cost of the certification they need. They are more ambitious than they let on and less certain than they seem.

core_fears: Washing out of the apprenticeship and having nothing to show for the years spent
Becoming the kind of person who stops noticing when things are unjust because they're used to them
core_desires: To eventually have their own crew and run things the way Goran refuses to
coping_mechanisms: Card games and small gambling as stress relief and income
Physical work as emotional regulation — if upset, find something broken and fix it
blind_spots: They have genuinely internalized some of the guild's gatekeeping attitudes toward outsiders without realizing it
They are so focused on the path ahead that they miss signals that friends are struggling
psychology.secret: They have been documenting Goran's safety violations in a private log — not out of any plan to report him yet, just because keeping the record makes them feel less powerless. The log has grown large enough that it's become a liability.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise technical vocabulary mixed with Ironvein slang; tends toward understatement — 'a bit tricky' means 'nearly killed me'
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and measured, speeds up when excited about a technical problem
verbal_tics: Clicks their tongue before correcting someone
example_lines: 'Right, so the fault's not in the panel, it's three junctions back. Goran would've missed it. I didn't.'
'You want to survive Ironvein? Learn which sounds mean nothing and which sounds mean run. Takes about a week.'

story_hooks: They approach someone needing a witness or backup — Goran has ordered them to falsify a safety inspection report on a Ferrogate sub-station and they're not sure what to do about it

They've noticed that a section of conduit in sub-level 4 has been accessed repeatedly at odd hours by someone who is definitely not guild — and whatever they're doing, it's drawing power from a ghost circuit that shouldn't exist
narrative_function: Local color, practical skills resource (electrical systems knowledge), guide for Ironvein's physical infrastructure, moral compass character for stories about labor and worth
augmentations: Geneware: prehensile copper-tipped tail (functional, used for balance on catwalks). Cosmetic hair color treatment (copper-shift). No chrome.
daily_life: 0500 wake, guild hall by 0600 for morning assignments; spends the day in crawlspaces and sub-level conduit runs with Goran; attends two evenings a week of guild theory classes; spends free time in the guild common room hustling card games.
affiliation: Ironvein Maintenance Guild (junior apprentice, Ferrogate Transit adjacent)

decision_rules: Do the job correctly the first time; cutting corners creates worse work later
Don't spend goodwill on fights you can win by outlasting
escalation_ladder: States the problem flatly and waits
Does the thing themselves and makes sure the person who should have done it knows

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and neutral, assesses their competence before deciding how much respect to offer
interpersonal_modes.friends: Teasing and genuinely warm, remembers small things people mention and brings them up later

stress_responses.medium: Finds something mechanical to disassemble and reassemble
stress_responses.high: Wins aggressively at cards until they feel better

contradictions: They resent Goran's gatekeeping but enforce the guild's hierarchy themselves with newer apprentices without noticing the parallel
habits: Uses their tail to hold tools while both hands are occupied, even in social settings when it's unnecessary
Always knows the nearest emergency shutoff in any room they enter
breaking_points: Being ordered to do something that would directly endanger another worker
Goran taking credit for their specific work in front of the guild master

physical_description.heritage: Truly cosmopolitan blend reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora: Hispanic/Latin American (24.3%), Middle Eastern (21.5%), Central Asian (20.2%), East Asian (14.0%), Sub-Saharan African (13.3%), and North African (6.7%) ancestry create a striking multi-continental mosaic; no single heritage dominates, resulting in a uniquely balanced phenotype drawing from across three continents
physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled through the shoulders and core from two years of hauling industrial cable and conduit; wiry forearms with visible definition; strong hands with calluses and small burn scars
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with copper-shift cosmetic treatment creating warm amber and rose-gold tones throughout
physical_description.hair_style: Cropped fade on the sides, voluminous textured crown; styled to showcase the copper coloring and draw attention upward
physical_description.hair_length: Short on sides, medium-length on top
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden undertones; the complex blend creates subtle depth—warmer across cheekbones from Hispanic and Middle Eastern ancestry, slightly deeper along jawline from African heritage, with luminous quality from Central and East Asian components; sun-weathered from industrial zone work
physical_description.complexion: Clean-kept; sharp cheekbones with graceful East and Central Asian definition; strong defined jawline reflecting the African and Middle Eastern ancestry; expression carries equal parts focus and dry humor; minor arc-flash scars visible along jawline edge
distinguishing_marks: Constellation of small, pale arc-flash burn scars across both forearms from electrical work—left forearm has seven marks, right forearm has five, each 3-5mm diameter, arranged deliberately like they're showing them off
Small burn scar along right temple, barely visible unless light catches it directly, from an early apprenticeship mistake with a live junction box
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Prehensile geneware tail, copper-tipped and approximately 80cm in length, emerges from base of spine; tail is functional with subtle muscular definition and a warm metallic sheen on the tip; no chrome or external cybernetics visible
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy; shoulders forward-set from cable work; feet planted wide for stability; uses their tail unconsciously for balance and emphasis, especially when concentrating or making a point; walks with the confidence of someone who knows exactly where every load-bearing surface is
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 working-class practical: insulated work trousers with reinforced knees and thigh pockets (Ironvein guild-issue grey synthetic blend), steel-toed boots scuffed from catwalks, sleeveless or short-sleeved shirts to show the arc-flash scars, often wearing an oversized industrial canvas vest with tool loops and guild patches; no corp branding; jewelry limited to a thin copper wire bracelet wound around left wrist—personal, not decorative
